Honest feedback is useful.Use sample details only.Do not enter real Ghana Card details, banking PINs or payment information.Sample numbers and account detailsSign-up phone: 0241230123Verification code: 123456University: University of GhanaEmail: kwame@example.comChoose your own demo PIN during sign-up. Sample-account PIN: 123456.MoMo recipient: 0241234567 (sample network detected automatically). Bank recipient: 102345678901 at GCB Bank.Start from scratchUse the sample sign-up details below. Review the sample Ghana Card details, university and email. Create your Lumo account, then choose Add money.Open sign-upAdd moneyTry a sample MoMo top-up into the operational account. Bank transfer shows the account number and a GIP guide for your existing bank app. Never send real money.Open Add moneyMake a small budgetAfter funding, save food and transport costs. Choose the budget period. Budget costs apply to the operational account; saving a budget does not move money.Open PlanCreate a Money BoxOpen Money Boxes separately. Add a box, then fund it from the operational account. Check that the money moves into savings and can be transferred back without counting as spending.Open Money BoxesPay for lunchOpen Pay, then Campus Pay → Akua’s Kitchen. If lunch covers a saved Food budget cost, link it beside the amount so it is not counted twice.Open Campus PayTry a genuine PauseWith a fresh sample account, review a GH₵450.00 Lumo transfer to Abena as extra spending. The projection leaves GH₵270.00 operational money against GH₵320.00 of budget costs: GH₵50.00 short. Savings remain GH₵200.00. Try editing or cancelling before PIN approval.Open TransfersFollow your moneyOpen Money Story, choose seven days and a category, then inspect completed spending. Search the list and check the dates and total still agree.Open Money StoryAsk your moneyTry “I want to spend GH₵70.00 on food tonight”. Change the amount and check the answer against your saved plan.Open ChatTell us what happenedUse You → Ambassador guide → Leave feedback. Note what you expected, what happened and where you needed help. Download the feedback file and share it with your Lumo contact.Leave feedbackPause checks the saved budget against operational money. Money Boxes hold separate savings; transfer money back before using it for a payment. Money Box dates are targets, not forecasts.
